create_action_schema: create an ActionSchema with name, inputs, outputs, and description for an echo action
run_echo_action: run an async echo action that reads input chunks and writes them to output
make_action_registry: build an ActionRegistry and register an echo action with its schema and handler
test_action_runs: test an echo action by sending input, consuming output, and asserting the result matches
run_action_in_background: run an action in the background using run_in_background and wait for completion
